expert_docs.name: bioreactor_transport_plan
expert_docs.title: BiRD reactor transport refactor for cell-engine coupling
expert_docs.description:
Plan for the biomass-as-input transport refactor: extract the shared
gas-liquid transport physics into a module consumed by two processes
(BiRDReactorProcess standalone + a new BiRDTransportProcess that takes
biomass as input and emits only the transport contribution). Decomposes
into four phases (transport-process split, closed-loop liveness at
impactful density, coupling-interval tunability, reactor geometry).
Source for scaffold-from-plan. Upstream dependency for the v2ecoli
multiscale-bioprocess mbp-03 coupling study.

expert_docs.name: cell_side_interface_contract
expert_docs.title: Cell-side interface contract (substitutability)
expert_docs.description:
The substitutability contract lifted from the v2ecoli mbp
investigation. Defines what a cell-side engine provides (cell_mass,
external_exchange_fluxes, growth_rate) and what the reactor provides
(external concentrations, volume, dissolved O2). BiRDTransportProcess
is the REACTOR side under this contract; the Monod placeholder is the
trivial conforming cell-side engine used as the test fixture for the
coupled studies.
